abt.and: Texans believe in hard work, opportunity for all, and treating others the way we want to be treated
abt.but: our laws do not always treat everyone equally, and discrimination against gay and transgender Texans is out of line with the values Texans hold dear
abt.therefore: all Texans should have the right to provide for their families, live safely, and use public spaces without fear because of who they are or whom they love

m1.core_value: treating people the way you want to be treated, applied equally to everyone
m1.villain: not named; the harm is described as a gap between Texas values and Texas law
m1.hero: not named; the message speaks as Texans collectively
m1.ask: none stated directly; the piece is a values statement rather than a call to a specific action
m1.summary: Texans believe in treating people fairly, and our laws should live up to that belief for gay and transgender Texans too.
